subject: New standards
body:
Some people got through that shouldn't have. From today:

- Women only.
- Age 21 to 29.
- Within 10 miles.
- Non-smokers.
- Straight or bi.
- Heritage Party only.
- Fewer Y followers than me. I have 212.
- Earns 30,000 DOLR a year or less. I make 31,000.
- Body count 3 or under.

Same deal. Every swipe right or no pay.
